description: Docs gap: PUT /zones/{zone_id}/snippets/{snippet_name} requires multipart/form-data — a JSON `metadata` part ({main_module}) plus the snippet module file(s) — but the docs model it as a bare JSON PUT with no body members, so the live API rejects it with 'bad Content-Type, expected multipart/form'. Transcribed from the distilled SDK's putSnippet; the service key dictionary carries mainModule -> main_module.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Snippet metadata ({ mainModule }), JSON-encoded as the multipart `metadata` part.
Snippet module file(s), appended under their own filenames.
